data.summary: Beispiel Umzugslogistik GmbH invoices Laura Beispielwinkel €1,330.78 for the move from Schillerhöhe 5 to Neckarstraße 40 carried out on 17 March 2027, payable within 10 days of the invoice date of 19 March 2027.
data.explanation: This is the final bill for your completed move, covering the moving crew, a furniture lift, no-parking zone permits, and moving boxes. The total of €1,330.78 is due within 10 days of the invoice date; the app will show the exact deadline. Transfer the amount to the IBAN shown, quoting the invoice number UL-27-0331 as the payment reference, so the payment is matched to your account. If you believe an item is wrong, contact the company before the deadline.
data.tax_note: Moving costs can be tax-deductible in Germany if the move was work-related (beruflich bedingter Umzug); keep this invoice as a receipt in case it applies to your tax return.
